description: Source code implementing video capabilities rules and support checks within the starboard media namespace, including adding rules and verifying support for specific video configurations.

classes.name: VideoCapabilities::Rule
classes.description: Represents a video capability rule with codec, resolution, and frame rate.

methods.name: VideoCapabilities::Rule::AsString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the rule.

methods.name: VideoCapabilities::Rule::CanBeInferredBy
methods.description: Checks if the current rule can be inferred by another rule.

methods.name: VideoCapabilities::AddSdrRule
methods.description: Adds an SDR video rule to the list of rules.

methods.name: VideoCapabilities::AddHdrRule
methods.description: Adds an HDR video rule to the list of rules.

methods.name: VideoCapabilities::IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given video configuration is supported based on existing rules.

methods.name: VideoCapabilities::AddRule
methods.description: Adds a new rule to the specified rules list, with warnings if rules can be inferred.

methods.name: VideoCapabilities::IsSupported (static)
methods.description: Determines if a specific rule is supported within a set of rules.
